curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42084-1-1.pdf (the hook loader, its functions on page 46); omr/instructions/42084-1-2.pdf builds the alternate model

functions.does: The gear on top of the cab, behind the roof, steers the front wheels: its upright axle runs down through the cab to a lever under the front axle, which pushes both wheels' pivoting hubs round.
functions.source: book: steps 1-16 (the front axle, its pivoting hubs and the lever on the yellow axle, step 13), 29-30 (the axle up through the cab and the gear on top); page 46 (arrows on the gear and a front wheel)

functions.does: The gear low on the side of the bed, behind the cab, swings the hook arm back over the rear through a row of three 8 tooth gears: the hook at the arm's top lifts the container's front, tips it up and sets it down behind the truck, and swinging the arm forward pulls it back up onto the bed.
functions.source: book: steps 24-28 (the arm's pivot and the 8 tooth gears), 34 (arrows on the gear and the arm); page 46 (the container on the bed, tipped up and set down behind)

functions.does: The four wheels roll freely; there's no drive.
functions.source: inferred: nothing in the book is driven by the wheels

functions.does: The container comes off: it rests on the bed held only by the hook through the loop at its front, and rolls on the two small rollers at its back end when set down.
functions.source: book: steps 40-50 (the container and its rollers); page 46
functions.note: the container moves with the hook arm in the function above; letting go of it isn't a control
